subject: Seat-sharing: one rides, the other is dragged
alt: Subhani’s cartoon: at the upper right, hand-lettered words read ‘SEAT-SHARING...’. In the middle, Akhilesh Yadav in a red cap, white kurta and brown sleeveless jacket rides a bicycle and looks back, saying, ‘ARE YOU SITTING COMFORTABLY?’ Behind him his ally, in a white Gandhi cap, round glasses, a black sleeveless vest and a white dhoti, holds on to the rear of the bicycle and is dragged through the air; his legs are up, one shoe flies off and dust clouds rise. Subhani’s signature is at the lower right.
chutki: Akhilesh Yadav on the bicycle looks back and asks his ally, ‘Are you sitting comfortably?’, while the man behind him in a Gandhi cap is dragged through the air holding the seat; at the top it says ‘SEAT-SHARING...’.
The needle: in this seat-sharing there is no seat to share. One is riding, the other is hanging on behind. The picture itself answers ‘are you sitting comfortably?’: there is nowhere to sit.
